reason: I already reorder Toplux when it runs out, and $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19). I forget my vitamins half the time anyway, so I'm not paying more for a new one.
objection: It costs more than what I already take and those last longer. I don't see why I'd switch.
would_change_my_mind: A price close to what I pay now, around $20 to $22 for the 30 days, or a free sample so I can see if I actually take it.
